structured_output.summary: The change implements String.prototype.big as the spec says. It binds this as string, then returns ? CreateHTML(string, "big", "", ""). It propagates the error with `?` semantics by returning the helper's JsResult directly. It reuses the existing shared create_html helper from prototype_anchor, so the CreateHTML steps live there and aren't in this diff. The gate passes: the build and clippy are ok, and 4 new tests pass with no regressions. The only other edits are underscore prefixes on the now-unused parameters. I could not see create_html itself, which is outside the diff. The passing tests and clean build suggest it is correct.
